name: Nicosia (Cyprus)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the municipal emblem: a curved octagon in gold, representing the Venetian walls, enclosing a white dove on blue.
history: The emblem of the Venetian walls enclosing a dove of peace was established between 1971 and 1974, in the years before the island's division; the white flag bears it.

features.role: octagonal outline of the Venetian walls and bastions

features.symbolism: hope for peace in the divided city
